scope: Instrumented Chrome headless sparse live campaign, same local device; 7 seconds per case, DPR 1. Not a dense, 10-minute, GPU-time, foreground-play or human-feel measurement. Application sources were under active development, so the before/after samples are directional rather than a controlled whole-build comparison.
interpretation: Two full-screen CPU copies per frame were removed; both dynamically changing canvas textures are still refreshed and uploaded to WebGL. A frame-rate improvement or GPU gain is not demonstrated by these refresh-limited sparse cases.
